tagline: MAA is a multifamily-focused, self-administered and self-managed REIT owning and operating apartment communities primarily in the Southeast, Southwest and Mid-Atlantic regions of the United States
hero_kpi_rationale: Total Revenue is the primary indicator of the size and growth of MAA's business in the multifamily real estate sector. It reflects the company's ability to generate rental income and other income from its stabilized and development properties.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total amount of revenue generated by the company's real estate activities.
kpis.description: Represents total real estate revenues for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025.
kpis.signal: Modest revenue growth despite a slight decline in average rental rates.

kpis.name: Same Store Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenues from properties held and stabilized for at least 12 months.
kpis.description: Revenues from apartment communities held and stabilized for at least 12 months as of the first day of the calendar year.
kpis.signal: Slight decline in revenues from stabilized properties.

kpis.name: Non-Same Store and Other Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenues from recently acquired, under development, or lease-up properties.
kpis.description: Includes communities recently acquired, under development, or in lease-up phase, as well as non-multifamily activities.
kpis.signal: Strong revenue growth from new acquisitions and developments.

kpis.name: Property Operating Expenses
kpis.explanation: Costs related to property operations, excluding depreciation and amortization.
kpis.description: Includes personnel expenses, repairs, property taxes, insurance, utilities, and other operating expenses.
kpis.signal: Increase in operating expenses exceeding revenue growth.

kpis.name: Net Income Available
kpis.explanation: Net income attributable to common shareholders after deduction of expenses.
kpis.description: Net income available to MAA's common shareholders for the year ended December 31, 2025.
kpis.signal: Significant decline in net income, impacted by legal costs and asset dispositions.

kpis.name: Same Store Occupancy Rate
kpis.explanation: Percentage of residential units occupied in stabilized properties.
kpis.description: Measures the total number of residential units occupied by residents, representing the average of daily physical occupancy.
kpis.signal: Stable and high occupancy rate, indicating strong demand.

kpis.name: Same Store Turnover Rate
kpis.explanation: Percentage of tenants leaving their units in stabilized properties.
kpis.description: Represents resident departures, excluding internal transfers, as a percentage of leases expiring over a twelve-month period.
kpis.signal: Decline in turnover rate, signaling tenant satisfaction and stability.

kpis.name: Variable Rate Debt
kpis.explanation: Amount of debt with interest rates that fluctuate with market conditions.
kpis.description: Amount of outstanding variable rate debt as of December 31, 2025 under the commercial paper program, subject to interest rate fluctuations.
kpis.signal: Significant exposure to high interest rates.

kpis.name: DPS
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share paid, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of $3.06 in the latest year.

kpis.name: Cap Return
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last 4 fiscal years reported.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of $0.713 Bn in the latest year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout Ratio = Dividends Paid / Net Income, calculated over the last 4 fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Percentage of net income distributed as dividends: 159.5% in the latest year.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Annual consolidated net income, values extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 fiscal years 10-K filings.
kpis.signal: Net income of $0.447 Bn in the latest year.

kpis.name: Same Store Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenues from properties held and stabilized for at least 12 months.
kpis.description: Revenues from apartment communities held and stabilized for at least 12 months as of the first day of the calendar year.
kpis.signal: Slight decline in revenues from stabilized properties.

kpis.name: Non-Same Store and Other Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenues from recently acquired, under development, or lease-up properties.
kpis.description: Includes communities recently acquired, under development, or in lease-up phase, as well as non-multifamily activities.
kpis.signal: Strong revenue growth from new acquisitions and developments.

kpis.name: Same Store Turnover Rate
kpis.explanation: Percentage of tenants leaving their units in stabilized properties.
kpis.description: Represents resident departures, excluding internal transfers, as a percentage of leases expiring over a twelve-month period.
kpis.signal: Decline in turnover rate, signaling tenant satisfaction and stability.
